trello.name: Fix Android 14 Photo Upload Crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Deadline: Wednesday (before August 20 release). Issue: NullPointerException in media picker callback when user backgrounds app mid-upload on Android 14 (top crasher, ~4% of sessions). Steps to Reproduce: Start photo upload, background app before finish, come back. Action: Fix the crash and verify it is resolved. QA verification by Sam on Android 14 test devices as part of regression run.

trello.name: Implement Offline Mode for Notes List (Backend)
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Deliverable: Sync API endpoint. Requirements: Client sends last-synced timestamp, server returns delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution: Last-write-wins (no merge UI in this pass). Deadline: Code in review before Elena is out on Aug 17th/18th.

trello.name: Implement Offline Mode for Notes List (Client)
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Deliverable: Client-side offline support. Requirements: Local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay when connectivity returns. Acceptance Criteria: App works in airplane mode (view/edit notes), data reconciles upon reconnection with no data loss. Action: Update ticket with acceptance criteria.

trello.name: Migrate CI Pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Deliverable: Complete test and release pipelines in GitHub Actions. Requirements: Keep nightly build schedule, run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week. Condition: Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean, then turn off Jenkins. Proof of concept for build job already exists.

trello.name: Add Rate Limiting to Search Endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Context: Search endpoint degraded due to misbehaving script. Requirements: Implement per-user rate limiting of 100 requests per minute. Behavior: Return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded. Additional Requirement: Add a metrics counter to track who is hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update Consent Screen for GDPR Compliance
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Deadline: Must be in August 20 release (launch blocker). Requirements: Update privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in. Implement separate toggles for analytics and marketing. Ensure no boxes are pre-checked. Action: Get new copy from legal and rebuild the screen.

trello.name: Write Automated Regression Tests for Payments Flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Deliverable: Automated tests for payments flow. Scope: Purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths. Requirement: Tests must run in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
